summary: Establishes a PSC large-load registry at 25 MW or more.
notes: Distinct from the Next Generation Energy Act (Ch. 625/626 of 2025) large-load rate schedule at 100 MW or more with over 80 percent load factor, PSC regulations due June 1 2026 (DLS fiscal note HB 120). Two thresholds in two instruments, not a conflict.
